main_flow.content: The VMU User selects the distributor from the Distributor Master.
The VMU User enters the date of distribution and the quantity of vouchers required by the distributor.
The system allocates relevant vouchers with their numbers and batch numbers based on stock availability.
The system calculates the invoice amount as 'No of vouchers x Wholesale price'.
The VMU User confirms the mode of payment (Cash).
The system generates an auto-generated Distribution Invoice Number.
The system records the transaction details including distributor name, sales man name, date of distribution, voucher numbers, batch numbers, and invoice amount.
